t2.title: It better to rent or buy a home
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it better to rent or buy a home?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The rent versus buy debate is relevant for young adults everywhere. I believe the best choice depends on individual circumstances.

Firstly, buying a home builds long-term wealth. Property values typically increase over time, and mortgage payments contribute to ownership rather than disappearing as rent. Eventually, homeowners have a valuable asset.

Secondly, owning provides stability and freedom. Homeowners can renovate, decorate, and stay indefinitely without fear of landlord decisions or rent increases.

However, renting offers significant advantages. Flexibility is crucial for young professionals who may relocate for career opportunities. Renters avoid maintenance costs, property taxes, and the financial risk of falling property values.

Furthermore, housing affordability varies dramatically by location. In expensive cities, renting may be the only viable option for years while saving for a deposit.

In conclusion, young people should rent while building careers and savings, then consider buying when ready to settle. Neither option is universally better – personal circumstances determine the right choice.

t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I buy a table from your shop. The table is nice and I like it. The delivery was okay, but it was late. I think you need more chairs. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear HomeStyle Team,
I am writing to you about my recent purchase. I bought a sofa and a lamp. The product selection was good, you had many options. The quality seems okay so far, but I haven't had them for long. The delivery was on time, however, the assembly was a bit difficult. I think you should offer more help with assembly.
In my opinion, you could also sell more decorations, like pictures and plants. That would be helpful. Thank you for your service.
Sincerely,
Muattar Aliyeva
t2.sampleB2: Renting or Buying: What's the Smart Move? Ask almost any young person what they dream of, and owning a home is bound to come up. But with prices sky-high, is buying really the best path — or is renting an option worth a second look? On the one hand, buying a home is a solid long-term investment. Every mortgage payment builds equity, and over time property values tend to climb, leaving owners with a valuable asset. There's also a comforting sense of stability: you can decorate, renovate, and truly make the place your own. On the other hand, renting offers a kind of freedom that ownership simply can't match. Young professionals who may need to move for work benefit hugely from the flexibility to up sticks and go. Renters also steer clear of hefty maintenance costs, property taxes, and the risk of falling house prices. So, which wins? In my view, it all comes down to your stage in life. While you're chasing a career and building up savings, renting makes perfect sense. Once you're ready to settle down, buying becomes the wiser call. At the end of the day, there's no one-size-fits-all answer — only the choice that fits you best.
t2.uzSample:
Ijara yoki sotib olish bahsi hamma joydagi yoshlar uchun dolzarb. Menimcha, eng yaxshi tanlov individual sharoitlarga bog'liq.

Birinchidan, uy sotib olish uzoq muddatli boylikni yaratadi. Ko'chmas mulk qiymati odatda vaqt o'tishi bilan oshadi va ipoteka to'lovlari ijara sifatida yo'q bo'lib ketish o'rniga egalikka hissa qo'shadi. Oxir-oqibat, uy egalari qimmatli aktivga ega bo'ladilar.

Ikkinchidan, egalik barqarorlik va erkinlikni ta'minlaydi. Uy egalari ta'mirlash, bezash va uy egasining qarorlari yoki ijara narxining oshishidan qo'rqmasdan cheksiz qolishlari mumkin.

Biroq, ijaraga olish sezilarli afzalliklarni taklif etadi. Moslashuvchanlik, martaba imkoniyatlari uchun ko'chib o'tishi mumkin bo'lgan yosh mutaxassislar uchun juda muhimdir. Ijarachilar ta'mirlash xarajatlari, mol-mulk solig'i va mulk qiymatining pasayishi xavfidan qochadilar.

Bundan tashqari, uy-joyning arzonligi joylashuvga qarab keskin farq qiladi. Qimmat shaharlarda, depozit uchun pul yig'ish davrida ijaraga olish yagona maqbul variant bo'lishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, yoshlar martaba va jamg'arma yaratish davrida ijaraga olishlari, keyin esa joylashishga tayyor bo'lganda sotib olishni o'ylab ko'rishlari kerak. Hech qanday variant universal tarzda yaxshiroq emas – shaxsiy sharoitlar to'g'ri tanlovni belgilaydi.

Hurmatli HomeStyle jamoasi,
Men sizga yaqinda qilgan xaridim haqida yozmoqdaman. Men divan va lampa sotib oldim. Mahsulotlar tanlovi yaxshi edi, sizda ko'plab variantlar bor edi. Sifat hozircha yaxshi ko'rinadi, lekin ularni yaqinda sotib oldim. Yetkazib berish o'z vaqtida bo'ldi, ammo yig'ish biroz qiyin bo'ldi. Menimcha, siz yig'ishda ko'proq yordam taklif qilishingiz kerak.
Mening fikrimcha, siz ko'proq bezaklarni, masalan, rasmlar va o'simliklarni ham sotishingiz mumkin. Bu foydali bo'lardi. Xizmatingiz uchun rahmat.
Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Aliyeva
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli HomeStyle jamoasi,
Men sizning do'koningizdan yaqinda mebel sotib olish bo'yicha tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men qoniqdim, lekin takomillashtirish uchun bir nechta takliflarim bor.
Mahsulot tanlovi ta'sirli bo'lib, turli xil uslublar va narxlar diapazonini taklif etadi. Mebelning sifati yuqori ko'rinadi, garchi uning chidamliligini to'liq baholash uchun menga ko'proq vaqt kerak bo'ladi. Yetkazib berish xizmati qoniqarli bo'lib, belgilangan muddat ichida yetib keldi. Biroq, yig'ish bo'yicha ko'rsatmalar aniqroq bo'lishi mumkin edi; men muayyan qadamda qiynaldim va onlayn manbalarga murojaat qilishimga to'g'ri keldi.
Qo'shimcha mahsulotlar yoki xizmatlarga kelsak, menimcha, interyer dizayni bo'yicha maslahatlar berish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Ko'pgina mijozlar, shu jumladan men ham, mebellarni muvofiqlashtirish va uyg'un yashash joyini yaratish bo'yicha ekspert maslahatini qadrlashadi. Bundan tashqari, matolarni himoya qilish xizmatlarini taqdim etish dog'lar va eskirishdan xavotirda bo'lgan mijozlarga yoqishi mumkin.
E'tiboringiz uchun rahmat. Umid qilamanki, bu sizning mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishingizni yaxshilashga yordam beradi.
Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Aliyeva

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the furniture store. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HomeStyle Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your furniture store. I am very satisfied with my purchase. The product range was impressive, and the quality exceeded my expectations. Your sales staff were extremely helpful without being pushy. The delivery team arrived on time and assembled everything professionally. However, I have some suggestions. The showroom layout was slightly confusing, making it hard to find specific items. Additionally, the delivery window of 4 hours was rather inconvenient for working people. I would appreciate an interior design consultation service. A virtual room planner tool on your website would help customers visualize furniture. Also, offering eco-friendly furniture options would attract environmentally conscious buyers. Overall, I am delighted with my purchase. Yours sincerely, Muattar Aliyeva
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HomeStyle!

I buy chair. Chair good.
Delivery man nice.
I like shop. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello HomeStyle,

Thank you for the letter. I bought a table and chairs. The table is good, and the chairs are nice too.
The delivery was okay, but it was late. I was waiting.
Maybe you can sell more lamps? And maybe the delivery can be faster. Thank you!

Bye,

Muattar Aliyeva
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HomeStyle Furniture,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my experience with your store. I bought a sofa and I like it very much. The quality seems good, and it's comfortable.

The delivery was mostly good, however, the men who delivered the sofa were a little late. Also, I think you should have more options for smaller apartments. It was difficult to find something that fit my living room.

In my opinion, you could also offer some discounts for students or senior citizens. That would be a good idea. Overall, I am happy with my purchase.

Sincerely,
Muattar Aliyeva
t12.sampleB2: Dear HomeStyle Team, Thank you for your email asking about my recent purchase. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed with my experience. Your product selection was wide-ranging, catering to every taste and budget, and the quality of the furniture has exceeded my expectations. The delivery arrived right on schedule, and the team assembled everything with great care, which I really appreciated. That said, I would like to put forward a couple of suggestions. Firstly, the four-hour delivery window is rather inconvenient for those of us in full-time work, so shorter, more flexible slots would go down well. Secondly, I would love to see an interior design consultation service, as expert advice on pulling a room together would be a real bonus. Overall, I am delighted with my purchase and will happily shop with you again. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Umuman olganda, men xaridimdan juda xursandman.

Biroq, menda bir nechta kichik muammolar bo'ldi. Birinchidan, kitob javoni uchun yig'ish bo'yicha ko'rsatmalar biroz tushunarsiz edi, bu jarayonni keragidan ortiq qiyinlashtirdi. Ikkinchidan, yetkazib berish xizmati tezkor bo'lsa-da, yetkazib berish haydovchisi unchalik muloqot qiluvchan emas edi.

Yaxshilash bo'yicha takliflarimga kelsak, men aniqroq yig'ish ko'rsatmalarini berishni va, ehtimol, barqaror yoki ekologik toza mebel variantlarini kengroq tanlashni taklif qilaman. Shuningdek, mijozlar sodiqlik dasturi foydali bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylayman.

Umuman olganda, men xaridimdan qoniqdim va kelajakda HomeStyle Mebel do'konida yana xarid qilishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Aliyeva
